items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Jimmy Jones) narrates a story about the interviewer helping Claire Gordon. The interviewee only states 'I thought she'd passed' and does not describe any personal interaction, relationship, or direct knowledge of Claire Gordon beyond hearing about her situation from the interviewer.

ctx.x: Yeah, when we were doing the show?

Yeah. And he asked me to go see her, go find her and bring her over to see him, and so I did. She was staying in a little five dollar a night place near the Hollywood Ranch Market, and so I picked her up and took her over to see him and he gave her some money. She was completely down and out and in fact desperate for some kind of work or something, and she wasn't well at all and so shortly after that, I brought her over here and fed her a couple of times, because she was just wiped out. And then Claire Gordon…
